card.text: A star 94% of the Sun's width that turns once in 2.77 days, with a mapped magnetic field.

introduction.text: Waite et al. give it 0.94 solar radii, 0.95 solar masses, a rotation period of 2.77 days and an axis tilted 60° from the line of sight.

color.title: Photosphere color
color.summary: The color of the star's light, dimmed toward the edge by a model atmosphere.

radial-field-2006-12.title: Radial field, Dec 2006
radial-field-2006-12.summary: The star's magnetic field, mapped in this project from archived spectra by how it polarises starlight.

color-brightness.title: Color + brightness, Feb to Mar 2024
color-brightness.summary: The star in its own color, darker where its light shows it darker; the contrast is drawn stronger to be seen.
